Fails closed throughout: unknown manifest version refused rather than downgraded, untrusted signer refused although internally consistent, unreadable watermark refuses the install rather than being read as absent. cmd/nomad-browser-verify has no compiled-in release key and says so (EB-7). No installer integration, so this is a manual step (Nomad-browser 9121eca)
